subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Biodiversity Loss and Financial Risk
description: One-minute skill: Biodiversity Loss and Financial Risk.

hook.text: Bees disappear. Pollination stops. Crop yields collapse. $577 billion in annual food production depends on pollinators.

buildup.text: Biodiversity loss threatens ecosystem services businesses depend on: pollination, water purification, and soil health.

discovery.text: The World Economic Forum estimates that $44 trillion of economic value — half of global GDP — depends on nature.

twist.text: Financial regulators now consider biodiversity loss a systemic risk. The TNFD framework mirrors TCFD for nature.

climax.text: Nature is the ultimate infrastructure. When ecosystems collapse, economies built on them collapse too.

punchline.text: $44 trillion depends on nature. Lose nature. Lose the economy.

quiz.question: How much economic value depends on nature according to the WEF?
options: $44 trillion — about half of global GDP
